description: This file contains unit tests for the WebAudio SetCaps task, which configures GStreamer caps for a WebAudio player component. It uses Google Test framework to verify correct behavior of setting caps based on audio configuration, including handling of different formats, appsrc caps, and comparisons.

classes.name: WebAudioSetCapsTest
classes.description: Unit test fixture for testing WebAudio SetCaps task, setting up mocks and common test data.

methods.name: getPcmFormat
methods.description: Constructs a string representing the PCM format based on configuration flags.

methods.name: expectBuildPcmCaps
methods.description: Sets expectations for building GStreamer caps with PCM format details.

methods.name: expectGetCapsStr
methods.description: Sets expectations for converting caps to string and freeing the string.

methods.name: expectSetCaps
methods.description: Sets expectations for setting caps on appsrc if they differ.

methods.name: expectUnref
methods.description: Sets expectations for unreferencing caps objects.

methods.name: expectSetBytesPerSamplePcm
methods.description: Verifies the calculation of bytes per sample based on PCM configuration.
